plugins.name: agile-product
plugins.description: Product discovery — Vision Doc, PRD, Design Brief / Specs UI, ADR in Confluence.

plugins.name: agile-planning
plugins.description: Planning — Roadmap (short index + MVP/Iteration pages), Epics, Stories, Refinement, Sprint Planning.

plugins.name: agile-execution
plugins.description: Autonomous execution — implement the active board's sprint (Scrum/Kanban) ticket by ticket and self-review each PR. Needs gh.

plugins.name: agile-merge-review
plugins.description: Merge-review — deep PR review, fix-until-satisfied, rebase, Jira postmortem, multi-PR merge train. Needs gh. (Formerly dev-skills.)

plugins.name: agile-sprint-close
plugins.description: Sprint-close — tech-debt sweep, dev-stack closeout gate, QA validation (confirm-after-merge), retrospective.

plugins.name: agile-sprint-drain
plugins.description: Sprint-drain — auto-alternate agile-10-implement and agile-11-merge-train to a fixed point, with an actionable-work guard. Requires agile-execution + agile-merge-review. Needs gh + Atlassian MCP.
